A protocol exposing the hardware platform's capability set and display geometry to overlay clients

interface.name: deck_platform_v1
interface.description:
Tells a client what the hardware it runs on can do, so an overlay can decide which of its functions to run without reading the product name itself, and what the product is called, so a screen can address the user with the name on the box, and what the display looks like, so a full-screen surface can lay out for a round panel. All are fixed for the compositor's lifetime: they are derived from the hardware profile the compositor was started with, the same source bmc reports over gRPC.
The interface is event-only. Capabilities, the product name and the display describe the board, not anything a client could change, so there is no request beyond the destructor.

enum.name: capability
enum.description: One bit per optional hardware function. A bit that is unset means the board has no such hardware or firmware path, and a client should not start the function that depends on it.

entry.name: mining
entry.summary: the board mines; a BOS API answers on the local host

event.name: capabilities
event.description: Emitted exactly once per resource, as the first event on bind, and static for the compositor's lifetime.

event.name: product_name
event.description: The marketing name of the product the board ships as ("Braiins Deck", "Braiins Mini Miner"), for copy that addresses the user by it. It is a label, not an identifier: a client gates behaviour on the capabilities event, never on this string. Emitted exactly once per resource, right after capabilities, and static for the compositor's lifetime.

enum.name: display_shape
enum.description: Shape of the visible display area. The coordinate space stays rectangular regardless of shape: on a round panel the corners of a full-screen surface are not seen.

event.name: display_info

description.summary: the display's logical size and shape

event.description: The logical pixel size and the shape of the panel. A surface that covers the whole display is seen in that shape; a smaller one sits inside it and stays rectangular. Emitted exactly once per resource, right after product_name, and static for the compositor's lifetime.
